alerts.title: Iran war live: Third US carrier arrives, Iran warns it could strike first
alerts.why: Heightened geopolitical tensions in the Middle East increase the risk of supply disruptions and shipping chokepoint closures in the Persian Gulf.

alerts.title: Iran Claims Two More Oil Tankers Hit Mines in Strait of Hormuz
alerts.why: Escalation in the Strait of Hormuz threatens global supply chains and maritime transit, creating a significant geopolitical risk premium for crude oil.

alerts.title: Iran has exported 50 million barrels of crude oil since the US-imposed blockade was lifted two weeks ago. This equates to 1.66 million barrels per day for June 2026. Most other countries in the region
alerts.why: A surge of 1.66 million barrels per day of Iranian crude hitting the market significantly increases global supply, pressuring prices downward.

alerts.title: Iran has exported 40 million barrels of crude oil since 2026-06-15. Exactly half of that amount shipped out in a single day; which was last Friday (2026-06-19).
alerts.why: A massive surge in Iranian crude exports indicates increased supply hitting the market, likely bypassing sanctions and pressuring global oil prices downward.

alerts.title: Houthis edge closer to Aden as Yemeni forces pull out of Bab al-Mandeb
alerts.why: Escalating conflict near the Bab al-Mandeb chokepoint increases geopolitical risk premiums and potential for supply chain disruptions in global oil transit.

alerts.title: Houthi Advance Puts Saudi Crude Exports at Risk
alerts.why: Houthi advance near the Bab el-Mandeb strait threatens key Saudi crude shipping routes, raising potential supply disruption risks.

alerts.title: Oil tankers hit sea mines in the Strait of Hormuz
alerts.why: Sea mines in the Strait of Hormuz directly threaten 20% of global oil transit, triggering a severe supply disruption and massive risk premium.

alerts.title: Three tankers hit naval mines in Strait of Hormuz, Iran state TV says – AP
alerts.why: Strait of Hormuz mine strikes threaten major global crude supply choke point, causing extreme bullish reaction.

alerts.title: The Oil Market Is Brimming With Crude Despite Tanker Attacks
alerts.why: Persistent tanker attacks near the Strait of Hormuz threaten vital crude supply flows, maintaining a significant geopolitical risk premium.

alerts.title: Category 2 Hurricane Isaias nears landfall, leading to production shut-ins
alerts.why: Gulf of Mexico hurricane threatens production shut-ins and infrastructure disruptions, temporarily tightening crude supply.

alerts.title: U.S. economy added 165,000 jobs in October, way more than expected; unemployment rate slips to 4.1%
alerts.why: Stronger-than-expected US job growth and falling unemployment signal robust economic demand, boosting near-term oil consumption expectations.

alerts.title: UKMTO Reports Two Tanker Attacks in Strait of Hormuz
alerts.why: Attacks in the critical Strait of Hormuz threaten major global crude supply flows, sparking immediate geopolitical risk premium.

itemsSent.title: US Coast Guard closes Mississippi River at New Orleans after tanker collides with riverboat
itemsSent.why: Closure of a major energy transit artery disrupts crude and refined product logistics, creating short-term supply bottlenecks at Gulf Coast refineries.

itemsSent.title: Houthis Recapture Positions Overlooking the Bab el Mandeb
itemsSent.why: Heightened geopolitical instability near the Bab el-Mandeb strait increases risk premiums for tanker transit and potential supply chain disruptions.

itemsSent.title: Arabian Sea Ports are Booming as the Conflict Drags On
itemsSent.why: Increased shipping costs and logistical rerouting due to regional instability create a persistent risk premium for crude oil prices.

itemsSent.title: Goolsbee says Fed not on track to hit 2% inflation target
itemsSent.why: Persistent inflation expectations suggest higher-for-longer interest rates, strengthening the dollar and dampening long-term oil demand outlook.

itemsSent.title: $30 LNG meets the thinnest European storage of the decade
itemsSent.why: Low European storage and high LNG prices create a tight winter outlook, increasing competition for global supply and supporting natural gas prices.

itemsSent.title: Moscow’s Fading Shadow Fleet: Russian Oil Revenues are More Vulnerable than Ever
itemsSent.why: Increased enforcement on shadow fleets could tighten global supply, though actual implementation remains speculative and subject to geopolitical negotiation.

itemsSent.title: The Shadow Fleet in Crisis (highlights from an upcoming report)
itemsSent.why: Stalling shadow fleet growth and potential OFAC enforcement could tighten Russian export logistics, creating upward pressure on Brent crude prices.

itemsSent.title: Making the Baltic a "Shadow-Free" Zone (Brookings Paper)
itemsSent.why: Increased regulatory pressure on the shadow fleet could tighten Russian crude supply chains, potentially raising Brent premiums if enforcement successfully restricts tanker availability.

itemsSent.title: Iran Update, November 15, 2026: Yemeni government-aligned forces withdrew from most of their Red Sea coastal positions, likely to avoid a Houthi encirclement near Jabal Kharaz and to preserve their ab
itemsSent.why: Increased Houthi control over Red Sea coastal positions elevates geopolitical risk and potential threats to maritime transit security.

itemsSent.title: With the CPI and PPI in hand, core PCE prices are expected to have risen 0.29% in October, which would push the 3-month annualized inflation rate to 3.5%, a six-month high.
itemsSent.why: Higher inflation expectations dampen Fed rate cut hopes, strengthening the dollar and pressuring oil demand outlooks.

itemsSent.title: Houthis Recapture Positions Overlooking Bab el Mandeb
itemsSent.why: Heightened geopolitical instability near the Bab el-Mandeb chokepoint increases risk premiums for tanker transit and global supply chain security.

itemsSent.title: Oil Prices Fall as Fears of a Global Supply Glut Return
itemsSent.why: IEA report forecasting a return to global oversupply outweighs geopolitical tensions in the Strait of Hormuz, pressuring crude prices lower.

itemsSent.title: Black Sea drone attacks trigger Romanian fighter jet scramble
itemsSent.why: Escalating Black Sea maritime conflict increases geopolitical risk premiums and potential supply chain disruptions for regional crude and refined product exports.

itemsSent.title: China Turns to Iraqi Oil as U.S. Blockade Chokes Iranian Supply
itemsSent.why: Shift from discounted Iranian/Russian barrels to Iraqi crude increases global demand for standard grades, tightening the broader market balance.

itemsSent.title: The October jobs report is out Friday. Here's everything to expect
itemsSent.why: Market awaits payroll data to gauge US economic health and potential Fed interest rate trajectory, which influences broader energy demand outlook.

itemsSent.title: Firm Refinery Runs, Weak Demand To Build Gasoline Stocks
itemsSent.why: High refinery runs driven by strong middle distillates are creating a gasoline supply glut in Asia, pressuring margins and prices.
